register.reg_condition: when FEAT_NV2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: When FEAT_NV2 is implemented, holds the base address that is used to define the memory location that is accessed by transformed reads and writes of System registers.

configuration_text.para: This register has no effect if EL2 is not enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Base Address. When a register read/write is transformed to be a Load or Store, the address of the load/store is to VNCR_EL2.BADDR:Offset<11:0>.
Bits[63:n] are RESS where n is one of the following:

listitem.content: If FEAT_LVA3 is implemented, n is 57.
Otherwise, if FEAT_LVA is implemented, n is 53.
If FEAT_LVA is not implemented, n is 49.

field_description.para: If the bits marked as RESS do not all have the same value as bit[n-1], then there is a CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE choice between:

listitem.content: Generating a Translation fault when translating the transformed register read/write.
The bits behave as the same value as bit[n-1] for all purposes other than reading back the register.
The bits are treated as the same value as bit[n-1] for all purposes.
